svg.title: SoundPlant
svg.desc: SoundPlant turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a pocket groovebox: eight tracks, eleven engines, 93 factory presets and a 64-step sequencer. Eight plants in the track colours grow along a string under the name; a pluck runs along it as a pulse, sways each plant as it passes and comes back upside down from the far end, while a pulse crosses the spectrum rule.
